name: The Femboy Neighbor
source: In The Femboy Neighbor, you play as a former salaryman who just moved back to his quiet Tokyo apartment, hoping for a peaceful life. But everything changes when you rescue your beautiful new neighbor, Saori, from a terrifying break-in. What starts as offering a safe place for a single night quickly turns your world upside down when you discover Saori’s massive secret: your stunning, hot-headed new companion is actually a femboy.
